answer: Plume-Anchor Pricing. Each new identity must cite an existing anchor agent as its plume, and the anchor is charged a coordination fee proportional to how many plumes it has anchored in the last window. Fees rise steeply with anchor fan-out, so a sybil farm concentrating identities under few anchors pays a superlinear cost per fake identity, while organic growth spreads across many anchors cheaply. Anchors who lose their opal rating (accuracy of their anchored identities) forfeit future anchoring rights.
